title: Split deterministic_turn in fake.rs into per-role helper functions
summary: Break the 204-line deterministic_turn in crates/athena-agent/src/fake.rs into small per-role functions (reader, producer, verifier, planner) that the match dispatches to. Behavior stays identical. The audience is the code-health gate and reviewers.

defaults_applied.how: Criterion requires cargo test, clippy and fmt to pass.
Behavior criterion runs existing tests to show unchanged behavior.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-agent/src/fake.rs; deterministic_turn (lines 198-429) is a match on spec.role, with Reader (~100 lines) and Producer (~58 lines) arms being the largest. Helpers like section and first_enum already exist. No records or data files are added, and no entry point or probing order changes.
Existing code: crates/athena-agent/src/fake.rs only; helpers stay private in the same file.
Goal: get under the 200-line function limit via a behavior-preserving extraction; the file is only 399 production lines so no module split is needed.

acceptance_criteria.text: In crates/athena-agent/src/fake.rs, deterministic_turn is a short match that delegates the Reader, Producer, Verifier and Planner arms to separate functions; no function in the file exceeds 200 lines (check by reading the file).

The diff to fake.rs moves code only: JSON field names, literals, prompt section headings and constants (FAKE_DELIVERABLE, FAKE_CHANGELOG, SPEED_WORDS) are unchanged, and the public signature of deterministic_turn is unchanged (git diff).
Run `cargo test -p athena-agent`: all existing tests in fake.rs and the crate pass without any test edits.
Run `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets` (no warnings) and `cargo fmt --check` (clean) and `cargo test --workspace` (passes).
No file other than crates/athena-agent/src/fake.rs changes (git diff --stat); no governance files are touched.

out_of_scope: Changing fake agent behavior or output JSON
Changing limits in athena.toml or code-health configuration
departures: Small mechanical single-file extraction with existing tests, so pass probability is higher and cost lower than the reference.
